Below the first two modules, draw a broad neutral-outline region labeled "Trajectory archive". Inside, draw a small genuine program genealogy: a0 -> a1 -> p, then p branches to c1, c2 and c3. A tiny label below the genealogy reads "formation · edits · outcomes".
Below Evaluate, draw an amber region with two small stacked modules: "Reflect" above "Conditional experience". Inside the latter, only the three short lines "computation", "conditions", "lesson". A downward arrow from Reflect to Conditional experience indicates distillation.
CONNECTIONS: Evaluate has one downward routed solid arrow entering the right edge of Trajectory archive, labeled "record". Trajectory archive sends an upward blue arrow to Allocate, labeled "comparable returns"; a separate upward teal arrow to Generate, labeled "local context"; and a horizontal amber arrow to Reflect, labeled "related edits". Conditional experience sends a routed amber arrow up into Generate, labeled "Refine / Crossover". Draw NO experience-to-Allocate arrow and do NOT suggest Explore reads experience. Left side has two aligned input boxes: upper blue-outline "Candidate actions" containing three small symbolic action chips "(p, R)", "(p, E)", "(p, C, q)" and an attached small line "Base weights β"; lower neutral "Evaluated attempts" containing three small parent -> edit -> result strips, with a small label "measured best-so-far gain". Middle-left, reached only from Evaluated attempts, is a neutral region "Comparable feedback" split into two stacked compartments. Top compartment: "Local" with sublabel "same action". Bottom: "Shared" with three compact labels "same operator", "similar quality", "recent". Under Shared, add a tiny additional label "trajectory similarity". Avoid scatterplots and axes, which could look like measured data.
Middle-right is one blue-outline estimation module with two clear outputs, "Yield V" with sublabel "weighted gain / cost", and "Support η" with sublabel "comparable evidence". Local and Shared both feed this module. Candidate actions feeds only the Base weights path and supplies the comparison target; show a small thin connector labeled "current state" from Candidate actions to Comparable feedback if space permits.
Right side: one blue module "Correct weights", then an arrow to a separate compact module "Choose one action". Base weights β arrives at Correct weights through an upper bypass arrow; V and η arrive from the estimate module. Inside Correct weights place only the exact concise expression "β × evidence correction". A small line below reads "weak support → base weight". Do not say the final probability stays identical when support is zero, because normalization can change it. Do not claim final probabilities are capped at 4×. Under Choose one action, a small neutral "Evaluate" box. A thin dashed loop from Evaluate returns to Evaluated attempts, labeled "observed result". Do not draw virtual offspring, two-step lookahead, Thompson sampling or a reflection model. The central insight should be visually immediate: comparable feedback determines both the yield estimate and how strongly it can modify the base allocation.

REFINE LANE, in this exact left-to-right order: a compact card "Formation path" containing a true chain a0 -> a1 -> p; a compact card "Same-start attempts" containing a fork p -> c1, p -> c2 and p -> c3 with short outcome marks +, =, −, and tiny sublabel "edits + feedback"; a full-code card "Current code + score" drawn as a few crisp source-code lines; then a right-end instruction region "Change one computation". Do not include a Formation path card in this lane.
EXPLORE LANE: only one input card "Current code" with source-code lines, positioned to align with the current-code cards above; right-end instruction "Introduce a new computation". No ancestors, siblings, references, score, failures, or experience cards in this lane. Keep the intentionally empty area clean rather than filling it with crossed-out icons.
